title: Pancreatic beta cell function CRISPR screen (Rottner AK et al., 2023)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

A genome-wide CRISPR screen identifies CALCOCO2 as a regulator of beta cell function influencing type 2 diabetes risk.
Rottner AK et al.
Nat Genet. 2023 Jan;55(1):54-65. doi: 10.1038/s41588-022-01261-2.
PMID: 36543916

In this study, a genome-wide pooled CRISPR loss-of-function screen was performed in the human pancreatic EndoC-βH1 cell line and intracellular insulin content was measured.

The table below lists the 580 genes that were considered to be robust, reproducible screening hits, with FDR < 0.1 for at least two of the four sgRNAs in both independent screening replicates.

View results from this study in the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
